# Managed instances must terminate on real compiler-generated ownership checks.
# Only the uninstrumented dispatcher injects foreign pointers into typed slots;
# normal SDK dispatch transfers bytes instead.
[short] skip
[compiler:gccgo] skip

go build -gcflags=example.org/isolatefault/jobs=-d=isolateheap=2 -o fault.exe ./host
exec ./fault.exe
stdout -count=2 '^managed read terminated$'
stdout -count=2 '^managed write terminated$'
stdout -count=2 '^managed publication terminated$'
stdout '^host alive$'

[race] go build -race -gcflags=example.org/isolatefault/jobs=-d=isolateheap=2 -o fault-race.exe ./host
[race] exec ./fault-race.exe
[race] stdout -count=2 '^managed read terminated$'
[race] stdout -count=2 '^managed write terminated$'
[race] stdout -count=2 '^managed publication terminated$'
[race] stdout '^host alive$'

-- go.mod --
module example.org/isolatefault

go 1.26
-- jobs/jobs.go --
package jobs

import "example.org/isolatefault/dispatch"

//go:isolate
func Probe(p *int, mode int) {
    defer func() {
        _ = recover()
        panic("application recover/defer ran after ownership violation")
    }()
    switch mode {
    case 0: dispatch.Use(*p)
    case 1: *p = 9
    case 2:
        slot := new(*int)
        *slot = p
        dispatch.Keep(slot)
    }
}
-- dispatch/dispatch.go --
package dispatch

import "isolate"

// These deliberately uninstrumented test-only helpers force values to escape
// and inject a foreign argument without hiding the operation inside Probe.
var sink **int

//go:noinline
func Keep(p **int) { sink = p }

//go:noinline
func Use(n int) {}

func Program(h isolate.Handle, foreign *int, mode int) isolate.Program {
    return h.ProgramWithHandle(func(h isolate.Handle) {
        err := h.Invoke(func(v ...isolate.Value) error {
            *v[0].Pointer.(**int) = foreign
            *v[1].Pointer.(*int) = mode
            return nil
        }, func(...isolate.Value) error { return nil })
        panic(err) // Any return means containment failed.
    })
}
-- host/main.go --
package main

import (
    "context"
    "errors"
    "fmt"
    "isolate"
    "time"

    "example.org/isolatefault/dispatch"
    "example.org/isolatefault/jobs"
)

func main() {
    handle, ok := isolate.LookupFunction(jobs.Probe)
    if !ok { panic("missing marked function") }
    now := time.Date(2025, time.January, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
    foreign := new(int)
    *foreign = 7
    names := []string{"read", "write", "publication"}
    reasons := []string{"isolate: read from foreign heap", "isolate: write to foreign heap", "isolate: foreign heap reference publication"}
    for _, deterministic := range []bool{false, true} {
        for mode, name := range names {
            i, err := isolate.New(isolate.Config{Program: dispatch.Program(handle, foreign, mode), Deterministic: deterministic, InitialTime: &now, TimerOp: 1})
            if err != nil { panic(err) }
            if err := i.Start(); err != nil { panic(err) }
            var fault *isolate.OwnershipError
            if err := i.Wait(); !errors.As(err, &fault) || fault.Reason != reasons[mode] { panic(fmt.Sprintf("wrong fault: %v", err)) }
            ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
            err = i.Kill(ctx)
            cancel()
            if err != nil { panic(err) }
            if err := i.Start(); err == nil { panic("faulted instance restarted") }
            if *foreign != 7 { panic("foreign data changed") }
            fmt.Println("managed", name, "terminated")
        }
    }
    fmt.Println("host alive")
}
